title: Water and Waste — Replacement of the Vacuum Toilet Assemblies by the Current Standard
abstract: Replacement of the original vacuum toilet assemblies by the current standard through an adapter frame, on the aircraft still carrying the standard of the supplier that left the aerospace market.

sections.planning_reason: The original vacuum toilet supplier exited the aerospace market and its authorised repair network has closed. The aircraft listed still carry that standard, and the operators concerned are cannibalising retired airframes for flush valves and rinse rings. A toilet out of service is not an airworthiness matter but on an aircraft of this passenger capacity it is a despatch and passenger experience matter, and two operators have begun placarding units off on long sectors.
sections.description: The bowl, the flush valve and the rinse ring are replaced by the assembly fitted to later aircraft, using an adapter frame so that the monument cut-out is not changed. The lower latch assembly D3830119707579 is replaced by the item used on the later standard, and plain washers EN887884-5C are used at the adapter frame interface. The waste disposal galley insert kit XAN707755-87 is refitted unchanged, and the obsolete spacer LN562957-2B at the drain line clamp is removed in favour of a bonded support.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Drain and flush the waste system and make it safe for maintenance. Remove the toilet shroud and the seat assembly. Disconnect the flush and drain lines and remove the original bowl assembly. Remove the obsolete spacer LN562957-2B from the drain line clamp and install the bonded support. Do a general visual inspection of the monument floor pan and of the drain interface and report any corrosion finding. Install the adapter frame on plain washers EN887884-5C and check it for square against the monument cut-out. Install the current standard bowl, flush valve and rinse ring, and install the lower latch assembly D3830119707579. Reconnect the flush and drain lines with new seals. Refit the waste disposal galley insert kit XAN707755-87, the seat assembly and the shroud. Do the toilet servicing and functional check of AMM-T-38-30-11-800-001-A, including ten consecutive flush cycles with the system at operating vacuum. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to the eight aircraft listed, all of which still carry the original supplier standard. Units may be converted individually at any base visit, since each toilet is an independent installation, and there is no requirement to bring a whole aircraft to one standard in a single visit.
sections.material_note: Kit K3830-1011-01 covers one unit and includes the adapter frame. Kit lead time is twenty weeks. Removed bowls, flush valves and rinse rings are scrapped locally; operators holding cannibalised stock of the original standard are asked to declare it so that the remaining population can be tracked.

type_data.compliance_time: At operator convenience, unit by unit, as the original standard becomes unsupportable.

issue.reason: Drain line clamp and shroud work issued as a second accomplishment block, so that the extended scope can be revised without touching the per-aircraft effectivity.

abstract: Replacement of the vacuum toilet assemblies by the current standard through an adapter frame, with the drain line clamp and shroud work as a second accomplishment block, on the aircraft still carrying the standard of the supplier that left the aerospace market.

sections.planning_reason: The original vacuum toilet supplier exited the aerospace market and its authorised repair network has closed. sections.accomplishment_summary: Block A, bowl assembly. Drain and flush the waste system and make it safe for maintenance. Remove the toilet shroud and the seat assembly. Disconnect the flush and drain lines and remove the original bowl assembly. Do a general visual inspection of the monument floor pan and of the drain interface and report any corrosion finding. Install the current standard bowl, flush valve and rinse ring, and install the lower latch assembly D3830119707579. Reconnect the flush and drain lines with new seals. Block B, drain line clamp and shroud. Remove the obsolete spacer LN562957-2B from the drain line clamp and install the bonded support. Set the clamp at the position given for the shell condition of the bay, taking the offset position where the bay carries an external doubler repair, and torque it to the value in the accomplishment instructions. Renew the shroud seal and confirm that it seats for the whole perimeter. Both blocks. Refit the waste disposal galley insert kit XAN707755-87, the seat assembly and the shroud. Do the toilet servicing and functional check of AMM-T-38-30-11-800-001-A, including ten consecutive flush cycles with the system at operating vacuum. Record the embodiment against the blocks accomplished.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to the eight aircraft listed, all of which still carry the original supplier standard. The effectivity is unchanged at this revision: what changed is what the bulletin installs, not which aircraft it applies to, and the accomplishment instructions are therefore split into two blocks so that the second can be revised on its own. Units may be converted individually at any base visit, since each toilet is an independent installation, and there is no requirement to bring a whole aircraft to one standard in a single visit. Block B may be accomplished on a unit that has already taken block A under the first issue of this bulletin.
